message.subject: Scaling what's working with GF 108
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Really enjoyed seeing the joint booth activation with our team at ISA in April—the anti-graffiti challenges were a hit.

Given how well GF 108 has performed in your manufacturing operations, I wanted to explore whether expanding Tedlar into some of your other product lines might make sense from an operational standpoint. A few of our manufacturing partners have found that standardizing on Tedlar across more SKUs actually simplifies their converting processes and reduces warranty exposure.

Would you be open to a brief conversation about how this might fit into your production planning? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Recent co-exhibition with DuPont Tedlar at ISA 2025 with joint anti-graffiti product demonstrations
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Operational efficiency through supplier consolidation and reduced warranty exposure
